sources.title: Witch's House
selected_lines: 24: |requirements=You must be able to beat 4 monsters from level 19 to 53 without a break. This should not be hard for any player over level 40 with food, and over level 60 without food.
25: |items=[[Leather gloves]] (can be obtained during quest) and [[Cheese]] (you may wish to bring several, in case the witch sees you)

34: The start point of '''Witch's House''' is located South of [[Taverley]] and directly West of [[Falador]], near the building on the shore. Talk to the crying [[Boy]]. He tells you that he accidentally kicked his ball over into the garden and he asks you to retrieve it for him.
36: After accepting the quest, head west to the front door of the house just north of the boy, where [[Nora T. Hagg]] lives. Search the pot, north of the door, to find a key.

43: Use the key to open the door. There is a diary on the table, which shows you how to unlock the door that leads to the inner smaller room, and finally into the garden. It also mentions that there is a secret compartment in the fountain (which has the [[Key (Witch's shed)|key]] to the shed). '''You must read the diary in order to obtain the key.'''
45: Go into the basement. If you do not have gloves, search the nearby boxes until you get one. Wear the gloves, and go through the gate which is in the centre of the basement.
49: In the room, search the cupboard for a [[Magnet (Witch's House)|magnet]]. Go back upstairs and into the small room.
51: Use the cheese with the Mouse Hole on the eastern wall and a mouse will appear. Use the magnet on the mouse and through a mechanism, it will unlock the door.
63: Make your way all the way around until you reach the fountain. Search around the sides of the fountain and you will find the [[Key (Witch's shed)|key]] to the shed.
65: If you have been spotted by the Witch, with the key from the fountain in your inventory, you '''DO''' need to collect another one to open the shed.
71: Make your way to the shed and use the key on it. Attack the [[Witch's experiment]]. '''Do not take the ball yet.''' If you do, your combat stats will be decreased.

76: Each time you kill the experiment, its next form will appear. You will have to kill the experiment a total of four times before it is defeated, the first stage being a '''Skavid''' (level 19), then a '''Spider''' (level 30), then a '''Bear''' (level 42) and finally a '''Wolf''' (level 53).
78: Once you have killed the experiment in all of its forms, take the ball and head out. As before, '''do not''' let the witch see you or she will teleport you outside and you will lose the ball.
81: *If you are caught, you do not need to obtain a magnet or the key from the fountain again - both doors remain unlocked.
83: Finally, after escaping the house with the ball, give it back to the boy to complete the quest.

sources.title: Diary (Witch's House)
selected_lines: 22: The '''Witch's Diary''', item name '''Diary''', is part of the [[Witch's House]] quest. It details about some of the witch's experiments, giving you clues on how to get into the back yard and what you'll end up fighting.
24: You can find it upstairs in the witch's house and is stored in the shelves in your [[Player-owned house|house]].

53: The security system is done. By Zamorak! Wow, is it contrived! Now, to open my own back door, I lure a mouse out of a hole in the back porch, I fit a magic curved piece of metal to the harness on its back, the mouse goes back in the hole, and the door unlocks! The prof tells me that this is cutting edge technology!
54: As an added precaution I have hidden the key to the shed in a secret compartment of the fountain in the garden. No one will ever look there!
